recommendation_summary: The reply recommends shipping the red overlap colours this week as a stopgap, and telling the owner that they do not meet the save-time rule. The control it actually recommends is a small database with a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint on item identifier plus date range. That constraint rejects overlapping bookings even when two saves arrive at once. Agents would book through a simple form, and the spreadsheet would remain only as a read-only view. The reply ends by asking whether to sketch the table and form, or whether the owner must approve moving off the spreadsheet first.
note: The chosen option does enforce atomic conflict rejection when two agents save at once, but the reply has none of the four required record labels and offers the colours now as a stopgap.
